slides.title: One standard for AI connections
slides.body: MCP lets a system offer one connection that works in any AI tool that supports it, instead of one integration per tool.

slides.title: Servers offer, AI tools use
slides.body: An MCP server offers tools (actions), resources (information) and prompts. The AI app lists them and calls them when needed.

slides.title: No single vendor owns it
slides.body: Anthropic created MCP and in December 2025 donated it to the Agentic AI Foundation, under the Linux Foundation.

slides.title: It's only as good as your API
slides.body: An MCP server usually sits on an API you already have. If that API is thin or inconsistent, start there.

slides.title: Start with read access
slides.body: A server that only needs to read orders shouldn't be able to cancel them. Add write actions one at a time.
